tha-ap56:2.1: nhānakāle ca → nahāpanakāle (bj) | bodhiyā → nahānakāle ca bodhiyā (bj: sīmu)

tha-ap56:4.1: buddhā → buddho (bj, cck, sya-all) | dhammā → dhammo (cck, sya-all)
